name: Veteran Uzzek

angles.text: As a warrior, you learn from Uzzek that brute force is not enough. True strength comes from disciplined study of combat.
As a member of the Horde, you honor martial skill and rely on veteran fighters at frontier outposts to guide the next generation.

faq.answer: Near the Durotar and Barrens frontier, Veteran Uzzek teaches young Horde warriors combat. He shares lessons learned through countless conflicts from his camp.
Uzzek is south of Far Watch Post, the orc garrison on the eastern border between Durotar and the Barrens.

aliases: what is the far watch post
faq.answer: Far Watch Post is an orc garrison on the Barrens' eastern frontier. It guards the crossing from Durotar and protects the Horde's border.
Young warriors seek Uzzek for combat instruction. The Horde prizes strength, but its finest fighters also master discipline, study, and martial technique.
faq.q: Why are young warriors sent to Uzzek?

aliases: what happens when you speak to uzzek
faq.answer: Uzzek welcomes young warriors to his post. He is ready to assess their commitment and teach them the ways of war.
faq.q: What does Uzzek say when you arrive?

faq.answer: The Horde honors warriors for their strength and devotion to battle. Its traditions also teach that mastery takes discipline and learning from seasoned veterans.
faq.q: How does the Horde view its warriors?

sections.body: Strength alone cannot make a Horde warrior a champion. The finest fighters stay humble students of their craft. Through discipline and study, they sharpen their instincts. Young warriors ready to pass beyond basic training seek veterans who have survived the trials of war.
sections.title: The Path of the Warrior

sections.body: Between Durotar and the Barrens, young fighters seek deeper guidance in combat. Far Watch Post watches the eastern frontier. Just south of the orc garrison, Veteran Uzzek teaches promising recruits combat and survival tactics. He has endured countless bloody conflicts and now guides the next generation.
sections.title: The Veteran at the Border

summary: Just south of Far Watch Post, recruits turn to Veteran Uzzek for lessons in combat. His years of experience teach young Horde warriors that strength calls for discipline and study.
